title: Oven Roasted Korean Lentils Bokkeum
description: A charred, crispy Korean dish featuring Puy lentils, roasted to perfection in the oven, perfect for a brunch mood. This raw-friendly recipe is made in a papillote for easy cooking and cleanup.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together Korean chili flakes, sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and honey.
Add the rinsed lentils, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the bowl and stir to combine.
Cut a large piece of parchment paper into a square and place the lentil mixture in the center.
Fold the parchment paper over the lentils to create a papillote, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Open the papillote and stir in the chopped scallions.
Return the papillote to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes, or until the lentils are crispy and charred.
